name: b2ige-verify
description: Independent deterministic verification for AI-written software.

interface.longDescription: Independent deterministic verification for AI-written software. Verify local repositories with approved hidden CLI tests, BehaviorSeal before/after comparisons, and durable SQLite side-effect evidence. Missing evidence never becomes PASS. Install the local v0.1.0 CLI or MCPB and configure a trusted operator registry before verification; no hosted service, API key, or telemetry is required.
defaultPrompt: Independently verify whether my coding agent finished.
Check for behavior regressions without changing the baseline.
Verify committed side effects and avoid false PASS.
